title: Maximum Candies You Can Get from Boxes
sourceKind: third-party mirrors via web search (official page not fetchable)
summary: n boxes with status, candies, keys and contained boxes; starting from initialBoxes, return the maximum candies collectible. A box can be opened if it is open or a key to it is held.
officialConstraints: 1 <= n <= 1000; 1 <= candies[i] <= 1000; key and containedBoxes lists are length at most n with valid, non-duplicate indices.

examples.note: Sample answers 16 and 6 were confirmed by a search snippet; the full example inputs in the visualization were written from the standard example and were not captured from a source.

visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts up to 24 boxes so the graph view stays readable. Requirements not fully verified: example inputs need checking against the official page.
